Here, we apply the addition, constant multiple, and power rules:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\frac{2}{{x}^{2}}-3{x}^{3/4}) \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(2{x}^{-2})-\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(3{x}^{3/4}) \\  & =2\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{-2})-3\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{3/4}) \\  & =2\cdot (-2){x}^{(-2-1)}-3\cdot \frac{3}{4}{x}^{(3/4-1)} \\  & =-4{x}^{-3}-\frac{9}{4}{x}^{-1/4} \\  & =-\frac{4}{{x}^{3}}-\frac{9}{4\sqrt[4]{x}}\end{aligned}
$$
